# Derivatives: The Math of Change

- Algebra: Constant rate of change (Straight lines)
- Calculus: Instantaneous rate of change (Curves)
actions.title: Introduction

actions.spoken_text: Hello rk1788375142996! Today, we're going to unlock the power of the derivative. In algebra, you learned how to find the slope of a flat, straight line, but the real world is full of curves. By the end of this session, you'll understand how to measure exactly how fast something is changing at a single, tiny moment in time—whether that's a car accelerating or a stock price moving.
